```{r Process datas}
# Define your project directory

dir.create("output_data", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Input spectral files (FCS or CSV)
dataDir <- file.path(getwd(), "input_data")

# Directory for results
outputDir <- file.path(getwd(), "output_data")

# Confirm the input folder contains files
list.files(dataDir)  # Should list your CSV files

# Read CSV files
data.list <- Spectre::read.files(file.loc = dataDir,
                                 file.type = ".csv",
                                 do.embed.file.names = TRUE)

# Check that files are correctly loaded
check <- do.list.summary(data.list)
print(check$name.table)   # Column names per file
print(check$nrow.check)   # Row count per file

# Merge files into a single object
cell.dat <- Spectre::do.merge.files(dat = data.list)

# Assign experimental group from filename
cell.dat[, Group := fifelse(grepl("PBS", FileName, ignore.case=TRUE), "PBS",
                     fifelse(grepl("J7",  FileName, ignore.case=TRUE), "J7",
                     fifelse(grepl("J10", FileName, ignore.case=TRUE), "J10",
                     fifelse(grepl("J12", FileName, ignore.case=TRUE), "J12",
                     fifelse(grepl("J14", FileName, ignore.case=TRUE), "J14",
                     fifelse(grepl("J16", FileName, ignore.case=TRUE), "J16", NA_character_))))))]
```

```{r Assign cell ID}
## ============================================================
## Quantiles → thresholds (permissive myeloid) + full annotation
## ============================================================
library(data.table)
cell.sub <- as.data.table(cell.sub)

## 1) Build quantiles for all arcsinh markers present
markers <- grep("_asinh$", names(cell.sub), value = TRUE)

qprobs <- c(0.50, 0.60, 0.70, 0.75, 0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99)
quantiles.df <- rbindlist(lapply(markers, function(m){
  data.frame(Marker = m, t(quantile(cell.sub[[m]], probs = qprobs, na.rm = TRUE)))
}))
setnames(
  quantiles.df,
  old = names(quantiles.df)[-1],
  new = c("Q50","Q60","Q70","Q75","Q80","Q85","Q90","Q95","Q99")
)

## 2) Data-driven thresholds (defaults + tuned exceptions)
# Default: Q90
quantiles.df[, Threshold := Q90]

# Myeloid (more permissive)
if ("Mac-1_asinh" %in% quantiles.df$Marker)  quantiles.df[Marker=="Mac-1_asinh",  Threshold := Q75]
if ("Ly6C_asinh" %in% quantiles.df$Marker)   quantiles.df[Marker=="Ly6C_asinh",   Threshold := Q75]
if ("Ly6G_asinh" %in% quantiles.df$Marker)   quantiles.df[Marker=="Ly6G_asinh",   Threshold := Q80]
if ("CD11c_asinh" %in% quantiles.df$Marker)  quantiles.df[Marker=="CD11c_asinh",  Threshold := Q80]
if ("F4_80_asinh" %in% quantiles.df$Marker)  quantiles.df[Marker=="F4_80_asinh",  Threshold := Q75]

# HSPC core markers (slightly permissive to avoid over-stringency)
if ("c-Kit_asinh"  %in% quantiles.df$Marker) quantiles.df[Marker=="c-Kit_asinh",  Threshold := Q80]
if ("Sca-1_asinh"  %in% quantiles.df$Marker) quantiles.df[Marker=="Sca-1_asinh",  Threshold := Q80]
if ("CD34_asinh"   %in% quantiles.df$Marker) quantiles.df[Marker=="CD34_asinh",   Threshold := Q70]
if ("CD150_asinh"  %in% quantiles.df$Marker) quantiles.df[Marker=="CD150_asinh",  Threshold := Q70]
if ("CD48_asinh"   %in% quantiles.df$Marker) quantiles.df[Marker=="CD48_asinh",   Threshold := Q70]

# Lineage-priming markers (slightly stricter than myeloid)
if ("Flt3_asinh"   %in% quantiles.df$Marker) quantiles.df[Marker=="Flt3_asinh",   Threshold := Q80]
if ("CD127_asinh"  %in% quantiles.df$Marker) quantiles.df[Marker=="CD127_asinh",  Threshold := Q80]
if ("CD16_32_asinh"%in% quantiles.df$Marker) quantiles.df[Marker=="CD16_32_asinh",Threshold := Q80]

# T/NK stay at Q90 (fine separation)
# TER119: keep high to only catch leakage in TER119− sorts
if ("TER 119_asinh" %in% quantiles.df$Marker) quantiles.df[Marker=="TER 119_asinh", Threshold := Q95]

# Optional: fine manual nudges (edit/remove if not needed)
# for (nm in c("CD41_asinh")) if (nm %in% quantiles.df$Marker) quantiles.df[Marker==nm, Threshold := Q80]

# Named vector of thresholds
thr <- setNames(quantiles.df$Threshold, quantiles.df$Marker)

# Helpers
pos <- function(m) {
  if (!m %in% names(thr) || !m %in% names(cell.sub)) return(rep(FALSE, nrow(cell.sub)))
  cell.sub[[m]] > thr[[m]]
}
q99_of <- function(m) if (m %in% names(cell.sub)) quantiles.df[Marker==m, Q99] else NA_real_

## 3) Reset annotation
cell.sub[, CellType := NA_character_]

## 4) Erythroid (only to display leakage in TER119− sorts)
if ("TER 119_asinh" %in% names(cell.sub)) {
  TERpos <- pos("TER 119_asinh")
  KITpos <- pos("c-Kit_asinh")
  cell.sub[ TERpos & !KITpos, CellType := "Erythroid (TER119+ mature)"]
  cell.sub[ TERpos &  KITpos,  CellType := "Erythroid progenitor (TER119+ KIT+)"]
}

## 5) Lymphoid (B was sorted out, so only T/NK here)
cell.sub[ is.na(CellType) & pos("CD4_asinh") & !pos("CD8_asinh"), CellType := "T cell CD4" ]
cell.sub[ is.na(CellType) & pos("CD8_asinh") & !pos("CD4_asinh"), CellType := "T cell CD8" ]
cell.sub[ is.na(CellType) & pos("CD4_asinh") &  pos("CD8_asinh"), CellType := "T cell (DP/CD4+CD8+)" ]
cell.sub[ is.na(CellType) & pos("NK1-1_asinh"),                    CellType := "NK cell" ]

## 6) Myeloid (relaxed)
cell.sub[ is.na(CellType) & pos("Mac-1_asinh") & pos("Ly6G_asinh"),                      CellType := "Neutrophil (Mac-1+ Ly6G+)" ]
cell.sub[ is.na(CellType) & pos("Mac-1_asinh") & pos("Ly6C_asinh") & !pos("Ly6G_asinh"), CellType := "Monocyte (Mac-1+ Ly6C+ Ly6G-)" ]
cell.sub[ is.na(CellType) & pos("CD11c_asinh") & !pos("Ly6G_asinh"),                     CellType := "Dendritic (CD11c+)" ]

## 7) Macrophages
cell.sub[ is.na(CellType) & pos("Mac-1_asinh") & pos("F4_80_asinh") &
          (pos("CD206_asinh") | pos("CD163_asinh")),           CellType := "Macrophage M2-like (CD206/CD163)"]
cell.sub[ is.na(CellType) & pos("Mac-1_asinh") & pos("F4_80_asinh") &
          (pos("CD80_asinh")  | pos("CD86_asinh")),            CellType := "Macrophage M1-like (CD80/CD86)"]
cell.sub[ is.na(CellType) & pos("Mac-1_asinh") & pos("F4_80_asinh"), CellType := "Macrophage (F4/80+)" ]

## 8) Megakaryocyte lineage
cell.sub[ is.na(CellType) & pos("CD41_asinh") & !pos("Sca-1_asinh") &
          (pos("c-Kit_asinh") | pos("CD105_asinh")),           CellType := "MkP (CD41+ KIT+/CD105+)"]

cd41_q99 <- q99_of("CD41_asinh")
if (is.finite(cd41_q99)) {
  cell.sub[ is.na(CellType) & (`CD41_asinh` > cd41_q99) & !pos("Sca-1_asinh"),
            CellType := "Megakaryocyte (CD41bright)"]
}

## 9) HSPCs — canonical set (NO ESAM/CD93 in identity)
KLS    <- pos("c-Kit_asinh") & pos("Sca-1_asinh")
CD34p  <- pos("CD34_asinh");  CD34n <- !CD34p
CD150p <- pos("CD150_asinh"); CD150n <- !CD150p
CD48p  <- pos("CD48_asinh");  CD48n  <- !CD48p
FLT3p  <- pos("Flt3_asinh")
IL7Rp  <- pos("CD127_asinh")
Fcgrp  <- pos("CD16_32_asinh")

# Clear any previous HSPC labels inside KLS only
cell.sub[KLS & grepl("HSC|MPP|KLS|HSPC", CellType), CellType := NA_character_]

# Order matters: assign most specific first
# LT-HSC
cell.sub[KLS & is.na(CellType) & CD34n & CD150p & CD48n, CellType := "HSC-LT"]
# ST-HSC
cell.sub[KLS & is.na(CellType) & CD34p & CD150p & CD48n, CellType := "ST-HSC"]
# MPP6 (subset of MPP4): FLT3+ AND IL7R+
cell.sub[KLS & is.na(CellType) & CD34p & CD150n & CD48p & FLT3p & IL7Rp, CellType := "MPP6"]
# MPP5 (myeloid-biased within MPP3 space)
cell.sub[KLS & is.na(CellType) & CD34p & CD150n & CD48p & !FLT3p & Fcgrp, CellType := "MPP5"]
# MPP4 (lymphoid-primed: FLT3+ OR IL7R+, excluding MPP6)
cell.sub[KLS & is.na(CellType) & CD34p & CD150n & CD48p & (FLT3p | IL7Rp), CellType := "MPP4"]
# MPP3 (default myeloid-primed when CD150− CD48+ CD34+ FLT3− and not FcγR high)
cell.sub[KLS & is.na(CellType) & CD34p & CD150n & CD48p & !FLT3p, CellType := "MPP3"]
# MPP2 (CD150+ CD48+)
cell.sub[KLS & is.na(CellType) & CD34p & CD150p & CD48p, CellType := "MPP2"]

# Fallbacks inside KLS
cell.sub[KLS & is.na(CellType) & CD34p, CellType := "MPP (other)"]
cell.sub[KLS & is.na(CellType) & CD34n, CellType := "HSC (other)"]

## 10) Generic myeloid fallback (Mac-1 moderately high)
cell.sub[ is.na(CellType) & pos("Mac-1_asinh"), CellType := "Myeloid (Mac-1+ mid)"]

## 11) Final fallback
cell.sub[ is.na(CellType), CellType := "Other/Unassigned"]

## 12) Lineage (clean with fcase)
cell.sub[, Lineage := fcase(
  grepl("^Erythroid", CellType),                             "Erythroid",
  grepl("^T cell", CellType),                                "T cell",
  grepl("^NK", CellType),                                    "NK",
  grepl("^Neutrophil|^Monocyte|^Dendritic|^Myeloid", CellType), "Myeloid",
  grepl("^Macrophage", CellType),                            "Macrophage",
  grepl("^MkP|^Megakaryocyte", CellType),                    "Megakaryocyte",
  grepl("^HSC|^ST-HSC|^MPP|^KLS|HSPC", CellType),            "HSPC/Prog",
  default = "Other"
)]

## 13) Quick QC
cat("\nTop CellTypes:\n"); print(sort(table(cell.sub$CellType), decreasing = TRUE)[1:20])
cat("\nLineage counts:\n"); print(table(cell.sub$Lineage))

library(plotly)
```

```{r plot options , echo=FALSE}
library(plotly)
library(data.table)

# Function for dynamic 2D UMAP visualization
plot_2D_UMAP <- function(group_variable) {
  plot_ly(
    data = cell.sub, 
    x = ~UMAP_X, 
    y = ~UMAP_Y, 
    color = cell.sub[[group_variable]],   # Color by selected group
    type = 'scatter',
    mode = 'markers',
    marker = list(size = 3, opacity = 0.8)
  ) %>% layout(title = paste("2D UMAP Colored by", group_variable))
}

# Example Usage:
plot_2D_UMAP("Group")  #PBS, J7, J10...
plot_2D_UMAP("FlowSOM_metacluster")  # Clusters



#Group and Time vizualisation 

# Make sure CellType is a factor with consistent levels
cell.sub$CellType <- factor(cell.sub$CellType)

# Ensure Group exists and is factor
lvl <- c("PBS","J7","J10","J12","J14","J16")
cell.sub$Group <- factor(as.character(cell.sub$Group), levels = lvl)

# Remove rows with NA UMAP or NA Group
cell.sub.clean <- subset(cell.sub, !is.na(UMAP_X) & !is.na(UMAP_Y) & !is.na(Group))

# Stable palette
ct_levels <- sort(unique(cell.sub.clean$CellType))
pal <- setNames(hue_pal()(length(ct_levels)), ct_levels)

# Animated UMAP (SVG, not scattergl)
p8 <- plot_ly(
  data   = cell.sub.clean,
  x      = ~UMAP_X,
  y      = ~UMAP_Y,
  frame  = ~Group,
  color  = ~CellType,
  colors = pal,
  type   = "scatter",
  mode   = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 3, opacity = 0.7),
  text   = ~paste("Group:", Group, "<br>CellType:", CellType),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "UMAP evolution across groups (PBS → J7 → J10 → …)",
    xaxis = list(title = "UMAP_X"),
    yaxis = list(title = "UMAP_Y"),
    legend = list(itemsizing = "constant")
  ) %>%
  animation_opts(frame = 600, transition = 0, redraw = FALSE) %>%
  animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Time: "))

p8

#checkboxes celltypes / time 
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(scales)

## 1) Clean inputs
lvl_time <- c("PBS","J7","J10","J12","J14","J16")
cell.sub$Group    <- factor(as.character(cell.sub$Group), levels = lvl_time)
cell.sub$CellType <- factor(as.character(cell.sub$CellType))   # keep your labels

df <- subset(cell.sub, !is.na(UMAP_X) & !is.na(UMAP_Y) & !is.na(Group) & !is.na(CellType))

## 2) SharedData keyed by row (for filtering)
sd <- SharedData$new(df, key = ~seq_len(nrow(df)), group = "umapCT")

## 3) Stable palette for time (Group)
grp_cols <- setNames(
  c("#1f77b4","#2ca02c","#ff7f0e","#9467bd","#8c564b","#e377c2")[seq_len(length(lvl_time))],
  lvl_time
)

## 4) The plot (colors by Group / time)
p <- plot_ly(
  data   = sd,
  x = ~UMAP_X, y = ~UMAP_Y,
  type = "scattergl", mode = "markers",
  color = ~Group, colors = grp_cols, hoverinfo = "text",
  marker = list(size = 2.5, opacity = 0.75),
  text = ~paste0("CellType: ", CellType, "<br>Group: ", Group)
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "UMAP — colors = Group (time); filter by CellType (checkboxes)",
    xaxis = list(title = "UMAP_X", zeroline = TRUE, zerolinecolor = "gray"),
    yaxis = list(title = "UMAP_Y", zeroline = TRUE, zerolinecolor = "gray"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Group"))
  )

## 5) CellType checkboxes (multi-select)
# If your crosstalk version supports `selected=`, keep it; if you get an
# "unused argument (selected=...)" error, remove the `selected` line.
ft <- try(
  filter_checkbox(
    id = "celltypes",
    label = "Cell types",
    sharedData = sd,
    ~CellType,
    inline = FALSE,
    columns = 1,
    selected = levels(df$CellType)   # <— remove this line if your crosstalk errors
  ),
  silent = TRUE
)

if (inherits(ft, "try-error")) {
  # fallback that always works: a multi-select dropdown
  ft <- filter_select(
    id = "celltypes",
    label = "Cell types",
    sharedData = sd,
    ~CellType,
    multiple = TRUE
  )
}

## 6) Put filters on the left and plot on the right
crosstalk::bscols(widths = c(3, 9), ft, p)

library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(scales)
library(data.table)

# ---- 0) Prep: factors with fixed levels ----------------------
lvl_time <- c("PBS","J7","J10","J12","J14","J16")
cell.sub$Group    <- factor(as.character(cell.sub$Group), levels = lvl_time)
cell.sub$CellType <- factor(as.character(cell.sub$CellType))

# keep rows with coordinates + labels
df <- as.data.table(cell.sub)[!is.na(UMAP_X) & !is.na(UMAP_Y) & !is.na(Group) & !is.na(CellType)]
df[, RowID := .I]                      # <- global unique key

groups_present <- levels(droplevels(df$Group))
ct_levels      <- levels(droplevels(df$CellType))

# stable palette for ALL traces, regardless of current subset
pal <- setNames(hue_pal()(length(ct_levels)), ct_levels)

# ---- 1) One controller SharedData (drives the checkboxes) ----
sd_ctrl <- SharedData$new(df, key = ~RowID, group = "umapCT")

# CellType checkboxes (multi-select). If your crosstalk version errors on `selected=`,
# just leave that argument out.
ft_ct <- filter_checkbox(
  id = "ct",
  label = "Cell types",
  sharedData = sd_ctrl,
  ~CellType,
  inline = FALSE,
  columns = 1
  # selected = ct_levels
)

# ---- 2) One SharedData per Group (all share group="umapCT") ---
sd_list <- lapply(groups_present, function(g){
  SharedData$new(df[Group == g], key = ~RowID, group = "umapCT")
})

# ---- 3) One plot per Group, colors = CellType -----------------
plots <- Map(function(sd_g, g){
  plot_ly(
    data  = sd_g,
    x = ~UMAP_X, y = ~UMAP_Y,
    type = "scattergl", mode = "markers",
    color = ~CellType, colors = pal,
    marker = list(size = 2.5, opacity = 0.75),
    text = ~paste0("Group: ", g, "<br>CellType: ", CellType),
    hoverinfo = "text",
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) %>% layout(title = g)
}, sd_list, groups_present)

# ---- 4) Arrange grid ------------------------------------------
ncols  <- 3
nrows  <- ceiling(length(plots)/ncols)

p_grid <- subplot(
  plots,
  nrows = nrows, shareX = TRUE, shareY = TRUE, titleX = TRUE, titleY = TRUE
) %>% layout(
  title = "UMAP by Group — check CellTypes to overlay across time",
  xaxis = list(title = "UMAP_X", zeroline = TRUE, zerolinecolor = "gray"),
  yaxis = list(title = "UMAP_Y", zeroline = TRUE, zerolinecolor = "gray"),
  margin = list(l = 40, r = 10, t = 50, b = 40)
)

bscols(widths = c(3, 9), ft_ct, p_grid)
```
